variants.headline: Still in view: household savings committed to a company plan
variants.sub: Household savings have been put into a business plan by {founder}.
variants.body:
The settler {founder} has committed household savings to a plan for {business}. Coverage of this story continues; the original event remains the starting point for the questions examined here.

Our movement should take the conditions of starting a business seriously without making a plan into a political trophy. We stand with {target} against an easy verdict; a principled politics should also be a fair one.
